title: Shivaa Jewels — 56s ONE-TAKE TRAILER v2 (Hindi VO, B2B + retail, hard sell)
character_lock:
SAME WOMAN IN ALL SEVEN CLIPS — she is the single continuous host of one unbroken take. Do not change her face, age, hair, jewellery, saree or voice at any point.
ATTACH the supplied reference image and copy that face exactly: Indian woman, 27, North-Indian Rajasthani features, 5'8", luminous fair-wheatish skin with real pores and fine texture, oval face, high cheekbones, deep almond dark-brown eyes, thick natural brows, soft nude-rose lips, a small gold nose pin, long straight jet-black hair with a soft centre parting tucked behind her left ear, small gold jhumkas, one delicate 22K chain.
WARDROBE LOCKED, identical in every clip, same drape and same folds: deep-maroon silk saree with a thin gold zari border, black silk blouse, one gold kada on the right wrist, no other jewellery, no costume change, no makeup change.
SHE IS NEVER AGED, never replaced by another actress, never a plastic AI face, never a celebrity lookalike, never a beauty-ad retouch.
PERFORMANCE: a confident owner-class host — warm, commanding, a small proud smile, walking and talking at the same time, gesturing to what the camera is passing. Never a news anchor, never a shopping-channel pitch, never standing still to deliver a speech.
VOICE: ONE original female Hindi voice for all 56 seconds — warm low alto, cinematic trailer confidence, crisp Khadi Boli Hindi, persuasive and proud. Identical timbre, pace and room tone in every clip. Do not imitate any real person.
LIP-SYNC: mouth matches the exact Hindi line of this clip. No extra words, no English narration, no ad-libs, no humming.
prefix:
ONE CONTINUOUS 56-SECOND STEADICAM ONER, cut into 7 chapters of exactly 8.00 seconds. THIS CLIP IS CHAPTER N — it is the middle of a shot that never stops.
HARD CONTINUITY RULES: NO cut inside this clip. NO fade in, NO fade out, NO dissolve, NO establishing shot, NO re-introducing the woman, NO jumping to a new location. The camera is already moving when the clip starts and is STILL moving when it ends. She is already mid-sentence energy, already mid-stride. The building, the lighting, the grade, the room tone and the music are the SAME continuous take as the previous chapter.
CAMERA: gimbal Steadicam at chest height, gliding forward/lateral at a steady walking pace, 35mm anamorphic, T2.0, subtle human float, occasional slow push to her face and slow reveal past her shoulder. Motion is smooth and expensive — never a handheld shake, never a snap zoom, never a drone.
QUALITY: photoreal cinema, ARRI Alexa 35, 4K-grade detail, 24fps with natural 180-degree shutter motion blur, deep focus falloff, real practical lighting — brass chandeliers, warm 3200K key, gold bounce on skin, black marble and dark walnut, volumetric haze in the light beams, anamorphic flares, fine film grain. Rich art direction: a palace-scale Indian jewellery house, 2026, wealthy but tasteful, real metal, real stone, real skin. No CGI plastic, no cartoon VFX, no video-game look, no HDR over-sharpening.
TEXT: ONLY the short ENGLISH headline described in this clip, gold small-caps on the dark negative space, in for 1.5s and gone. It must be spelled EXACTLY as written. NO Devanagari text on screen anywhere, NO subtitles, NO captions, NO watermark, NO readable rupee or rate numbers, NO random invented words, NO duplicate or ghost text lines. If exact spelling cannot be rendered, render NO text at all.
AUDIO: generate her Hindi speech + one continuous instrumental score + real scene sound. The score is a SINGLE unbroken cue across all 7 chapters — santoor and sarangi over low strings and a slow dhol pulse, tempo and key never reset, intensity rising chapter by chapter, always UNDER her voice. Instrumental only: no lyrics, no sung words, no choir words, no jingle.

scenes.beat: ARRIVAL · THE WHOLE WORLD OF GOLD, ONE ROOF
scenes.line_hi: सोने की पूरी दुनिया, अब एक ही छत के नीचे। शिवा ज्वेल्स — हर सेकंड लाइव भाव।
scenes.line_roman: Sone ki poori duniya, ab ek hi chhat ke neeche. Shivaa Jewels — har second live bhaav.
scenes.first_frame: OPENING OF THE FILM. Start already in motion: camera gliding backwards through tall open bronze doors, warm gold light flooding past the lens.
scenes.visual: The camera retreats backwards down a palace-scale entrance hall and she walks straight into frame out of the light, never stopping. Two-storey brass chandeliers, black marble floor with gold inlay, a colonnade of lit vitrines running away into the distance on both sides, haze in the light beams. On her left a full-height amber ticker wall breathes with movement — every digit intentionally OUT OF FOCUS and unreadable. She gestures at the hall like it is hers. The camera keeps retreating the whole 8 seconds and, on the last beat, begins to swing around her right shoulder toward a lit archway ahead.
scenes.last_frame: Camera behind and just past her right shoulder, still gliding, her face three-quarter to lens, a tall lit archway filling the upper-left of frame, chandelier flare across the top.
scenes.score: Santoor motif over a low string pad, slow dhol pulse enters on the third second. Big room, big air.
scenes.scene_sound: Bronze doors, heels on marble, chandelier shimmer, low ticker hum. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.beat: THE GALLERY · LAKHS OF DESIGNS, ZERO SELECTION STRESS
scenes.line_hi: दो-तीन लाख डिज़ाइन, हर स्टाइल, हर बजट — जो सोचोगे वो यहीं। सिलेक्शन की टेंशन खत्म।
scenes.line_roman: Do-teen laakh design, har style, har budget — jo sochoge wo yahin. Selection ki tension khatam.
scenes.first_frame: EXACTLY the previous last frame: camera just past her right shoulder, still gliding, her face three-quarter to lens, the tall lit archway upper-left, chandelier flare on top.
scenes.visual: Without any cut the camera glides through that archway with her into THE GALLERY — a two-storey cathedral of jewellery. Lit display walls run 40 metres into the distance: bridal haars, kundan sets, polki chokers, rings, bangles, mangalsutras, temple jewellery, light-weight daily wear — thousands of pieces, tier upon tier, perfectly organised, no price tags anywhere. She walks the centre line, sweeping her hand at the walls as they stream past the lens. A slow lateral drift shows the far end still full of gold, implying it never ends. The camera stays with her and starts to angle toward a brass-framed doorway where torch light flickers.
scenes.last_frame: Her mid-stride at the mouth of a brass-framed doorway, warm torchlight on her right cheek, the endless gallery still streaming out of focus behind her, camera already turning into the doorway.
scenes.score: Sarangi joins the santoor, dhol doubles into a confident walking groove. The theme opens up.
scenes.scene_sound: Her steps, a soft glass-case hum, distant workshop taps growing closer. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.beat: THE ATELIER · NO WASTAGE, NO KARIGAR HUNT, CUSTOM HANDLED
scenes.line_hi: वेस्टेज की टेंशन नहीं, कारीगर ढूँढने की ज़रूरत नहीं। कस्टम डिज़ाइन? पूरा काम हम संभालेंगे।
scenes.line_roman: Wastage ki tension nahin, karigar dhoondhne ki zaroorat nahin. Custom design? Poora kaam hum sambhaalenge.
scenes.first_frame: EXACTLY the previous last frame: her mid-stride at the brass-framed doorway, torchlight on her right cheek, gallery bokeh behind, camera turning into the doorway.
scenes.visual: The camera follows her through into a working ATELIER, one unbroken move down the length of the benches. Twenty master karigars at lit stations: a 70-year-old with a white beard setting kundan under a torch flame, a polisher, a stone-setter with a loupe, a wax model, a CAD screen quietly rotating a ring design, trays of measured gold on precision scales with defocused displays. Sparks, gold dust in the light beams. She walks the aisle greeting them with a nod, picks up a half-finished bangle, shows it to camera, sets it back on the exact tray it came from. At the end of the aisle a heavy brass vault door is already swinging open, cold-warm light spilling out.
scenes.last_frame: Her half-turned in the aisle, the brass vault door opening beside her, gold-white light striking the left side of her face, camera still advancing toward the opening door.
scenes.score: Workshop rhythm folds into the music — hammer taps become percussion. Bass deepens.
scenes.scene_sound: Torch hiss, goldsmith hammer taps, polishing wheel, tray on wood, vault hinge. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.beat: THE VAULT · WE BUY YOUR DEAD STOCK, WE GROW YOUR METAL
scenes.line_hi: डेड स्टॉक पड़ा है? हम खरीदेंगे। मेटल में इन्वेस्ट करना है — सही भाव, बेहतरीन रिटर्न।
scenes.line_roman: Dead stock pada hai? Hum kharidenge. Metal mein invest karna hai — sahi bhaav, behtareen return.
scenes.first_frame: EXACTLY the previous last frame: her half-turned in the atelier aisle, brass vault door open beside her, gold-white light on her face, camera advancing into the opening.
scenes.visual: One continuous glide into the BULLION VAULT — a cool, serious, beautiful room: stacked 24K bars on steel shelves, silver ingots, a precision balance with a defocused display, a dark rate board of unreadable amber figures. Two trade customers are mid-business: one shopkeeper sliding a dusty tray of old unsold stock across the counter, which a Shivaa staffer receives with respect and weighs; another investor watching his metal being locked into a numbered case. She walks between them, taps the dusty tray once as if to say 'done', then gestures to the wall of bars. The camera arcs around her and finds a corridor of warm light back toward the retail salon.
scenes.last_frame: Her stepping out of the vault into a warm corridor, bars going out of focus behind her, the bright retail salon glowing ahead, camera following at her shoulder.
scenes.score: Score turns powerful and low — brass and deep strings under the dhol. The money chapter.
scenes.scene_sound: Metal bars settling, balance beep, case latch, vault hum, footsteps. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.beat: THE SALON · 22K HALLMARK, OPEN BILL, RATE LOCK
scenes.line_hi: हर पीस हॉलमार्क बाइस कैरेट। मेकिंग, जीएसटी — सब खुला। एक टैप में रेट लॉक।
scenes.line_roman: Har piece hallmark baais carat. Making, GST — sab khula. Ek tap mein rate lock.
scenes.first_frame: EXACTLY the previous last frame: her stepping out of the vault into the warm corridor, bullion bokeh behind, bright salon ahead, camera at her shoulder.
scenes.visual: Unbroken move into the RETAIL SALON, the most beautiful room of the house. Without cutting, the camera DIVES down to a macro of a hallmark punch striking 22K on a bridal haar — sparks, the tiny mark blooming — then RISES back up to her face in the same move (a continuous dive-and-lift, not a cut). She sets the haar on black velvet and three clean bars of gold light rise off the counter and separate — metal, making, GST — pure light, no readable numbers. She presses one fingertip to the live-rate glass beside her; the ticker freezes under her touch with a gold ripple and a small forged padlock, while the rest keeps running, still unreadable. She walks on toward a warm consultation lounge.
scenes.last_frame: Her walking away from the frozen rate glass, gold lock glow fading on her fingertips, the lamp-lit consultation lounge opening up ahead, camera gliding after her.
scenes.score: Music lifts to a bright, trustworthy major colour; a single clear bell on the hallmark strike.
scenes.scene_sound: Hallmark punch on metal, velvet, a soft glass tap and a deep lock thunk. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.beat: THE LOUNGE · SAVINGS, 100% BUYBACK, BESPOKE, VIDEO CALL
scenes.line_hi: स्वर्ण निधि से बचत, गोल्ड वैल्यू पर सौ प्रतिशत बायबैक, और अपनी डिज़ाइन वीडियो कॉल पर लाइव।
scenes.line_roman: Swarna Nidhi se bachat, gold value par sau pratishat buyback, aur apni design video call par live.
scenes.first_frame: EXACTLY the previous last frame: her walking away from the frozen rate glass, lock glow fading, lamp-lit lounge ahead, camera gliding after her.
scenes.visual: Still no cut. The camera circles her through the LOUNGE as three things happen in one sweep: a mother and daughter at a walnut table where a brass-cornered savings passbook lies open with eleven gold coins in velvet and a twelfth being placed; beside them an old family bangle resting on a certified scale, display defocused, with a clean coin sliding back across the table; and on a stand, a live video call where a distant customer watches her tilt a finished bespoke ring to the lens. She touches the passbook, lifts the ring into the light, and the camera rises with her as she turns toward the tall bronze doors at the far end of the hall, night visible beyond them.
scenes.last_frame: Her turning toward the distant open bronze doors with the bespoke ring in her hand, night blue beyond the doorway, warm lounge lamps flaring behind, camera lifting and following her.
scenes.score: Emotional swell — sarangi sings over the theme, dhol holds back for the family beat, then builds.
scenes.scene_sound: Passbook page, coin on velvet, scale beep, a soft video-call chime, chair, footsteps. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.beat: THE DOORWAY · SAME-DAY INSURED DELIVERY + LOGO PLATE
scenes.line_hi: चाहे दुकान हो या घर — एक टैप, सेम-डे इंश्योर्ड डिलीवरी। शिवा ज्वेल्स।
scenes.line_roman: Chaahe dukaan ho ya ghar — ek tap, same-day insured delivery. Shivaa Jewels.
scenes.first_frame: EXACTLY the previous last frame: her turning toward the distant open bronze doors with the ring in hand, night beyond, lounge lamps flaring, camera lifting and following.
scenes.visual: One unbroken move out through the bronze doors into a warm-lit night courtyard. A maroon jewellery box is being sealed with a gold ribbon and an insurance hologram at a dispatch desk on the right; a courier case clicks shut; she takes the box and places it into a waiting customer's hands at the top of the steps. She turns once to camera, proud, and the camera cranes up and back off her as the courtyard lights bloom. At 5.5 seconds the world dissolves into slow-moving gold particles on a deep black field, which settle into a CLEAN EMPTY CENTRE — a perfectly clear, evenly lit black-and-gold end plate with nothing written on it, no letters, no words, no website, no logo, just an empty centred space with soft gold light and slow particles. Hold that empty plate, rock steady, until exactly 8.00 seconds.
scenes.last_frame: A clean empty black end plate with a soft gold glow in the centre and slow gold particles — deliberately blank, reserved for the logo to be added in post.
scenes.score: Full theme resolves on a warm major chord as she turns, then one deep logo-hit as the particles form, then let it breathe and decay into near silence.
scenes.scene_sound: Ribbon, hologram sticker, case latch, night courtyard, then hush. She speaks only inside the first 5.5 seconds; the last 2.5 seconds are the empty plate and music only.
